summary: Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ quadrilateral ABCD (AD parallel to BC) with both diagonals AC and BD, the crossing point left unlabelled. Vertex labels A, B, C, D were bound by CV and confirmed visually. Version 2 is best: it compiled, and the critic scored it 0.9 with no must_repair flag, no extra labels, and no missing labels. No right-angle marks were verified, so none are drawn.
